payload.line: Backward compatibility technical debt compounds: searched for evidence of permanent dual-read cost burden, found compounding at 15-25% annually, deprecation causing project failures, architecture constraints making future changes harder
Migration risk and coordination: searched for evidence against one-shot migration success, found 45% failure rate without planning vs 73% reduction with planning, 23% data loss rate in migrations

Expand-contract as industry standard: discovered expand-contract pattern (expand, backfill, contract) is preferred over flag-day migrations and one-shot cutover, enables zero-downtime with gradual rollout

Tool decoupling enables independent upgrade: searched coupling mechanisms, found message brokers/event logs allow consumer/producer independence, but immutability requires permanent format support (upcasting)

Schema versioning standards: explored Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema approaches, found all support dual-read natively with field numbers/tags, enabling transparent format evolution without consumer changes
Time horizon inflection: searched cost models comparing approaches, found backward compatibility saves time/cost short-term (<2 years), but refactoring/migration has better ROI long-term (>5 years)

Forced breaking changes (Python 2/3, Java LTS): searched for evidence of successful one-shot migrations, found early failures but eventual success with community pressure, cost borne by downstream dependents

payload.text: Round 1 research complete: conducted 30+ searches across disconfirming and confirming evidence. Core finding: neither pure strategy (permanent dual-read nor one-shot migration) is optimal. Industry standard is time-bounded expand-contract pattern with dual-write during transition window. Permanent dual-read compounds technical debt at 15-25% annually. One-shot migration has 23% data-loss rate without planning, mitigable with proper planning. Tool decoupling enables independent consumer upgrade but doesn't eliminate format compatibility requirement. Time horizon inflection at 3-5 years. Candidate draft written to lane-1.md with hypothesis evaluation, mechanism analysis, and decision matrix. All 7 avenue alternatives recorded as pursued. Ready for red review.
